title: Moment
description: A GoPro lies on the grass looking straight up into a summer sky, and a man jumps over it. Two frames, half a second apart, are all there is: drag across the picture and you move through the instant between them, his arms opening and his feet coming at you along their real motion, while the camera drifts a few degrees round him so the tree, the post and the hotel slide against the cumulus. Nothing between the two presses was filmed; it is rebuilt from depth, layers and flow.
intent: 3D Moments (Wang et al., CVPR 2022, https://3d-moments.github.io/ , Apache-2.0): space-time view synthesis from two near-duplicate photos, done DIY on CPU after factory/reality/techniques.md section 11 and herb's depth research (factory/reality/crowdvolt-depth-heroes.md). Clean plate from the clip's own frames (LaMa only for the last 0.25 %), sky deepened toward the zenith, sky/near layers with MoGe-2 depth, SAM 2.1 mattes, DIS flow chained through the frames between the two presses, bidirectional mesh warp in the shader, shared film grade (summer). ?t=0..1 time, ?cam=-1..1 orbit.

sources.note: 1920x1440, 24 fps, 6.5 s, GoPro on the ground. Frames 78 and 90 are the two shutter presses that ship; frames 0-120 were used only to clear the plate behind the jumper (YOLO boxes say which frames may lend a pixel) and to track his motion (DIS flow chained frame to frame). Registered by phase correlation (about 2 px of drift); the hotel's name on its canopy (LaMa) and the birds (Telea) removed; the sky layer re-baked from frames 0-112 at full resolution with no smoothing (registered on the drifting cloud; each pixel a trimmed temporal median of the nine usable frames nearest the shutter, the near-clipped cores from the single least-clipped frame round them), the cloud graded as its own pass (local contrast, a filmic shoulder that stops the warm tops near 245, a luminance-keyed split tone: sunlit tops to #F4EEE4, skylit undersides to #9FB6CF) and a dithered radial zenith gradient on the blue; the overhead wires' ghosts pushed out of it; the birch re-matted by closed-form matting on the frames (its leaf gaps open onto the sky layer instead of carrying painted sky; the three wires to the post traced as continuous lines; floaters under 200 px dropped); shown full-bleed: the plate cover-cropped to the viewport with the jumper on a thirds line, the camera rolled 5 degrees so the post, wires and hotel converge on diagonals. The jumper re-cut from the clip's native 1920x1440 frames (708x732 sprites, never resampled; the matte's edge re-solved by closed-form matting at that scale, edge colour unmixed from the sky, motion packed at full sprite resolution) and graded as his own pass: shadow chroma smoothed, then a cool skylight fill (hue ~210) that wraps round what faces up, so the face, the arms and the soles read against the sky; no sharpening. Bake: tools/depth/bakes/moment/ (analyse, people, plate, flow, cleanup, export, matte, sky, jumper).
